title: Vendor Analytics — Sales by Category Doughnut
description: Powers the Sales by category doughnut. Filtered by calendar year only — not by the page start_date/end_date. Default year is the current year. Slice colors are assigned on the frontend — do not send hex colors.

endpoint.auth: Vendor Bearer token + Application-Token (same as other /api/vendor/* routes)

query.year: YYYY. Required. Calendar year. Frontend defaults to the current year.

fields.total_revenue: Sum of categories[].revenue for that year. Should match revenue-orders total_revenue for the same year.
fields.categories: Parent product categories with completed-order sales in that year. Sorted by revenue descending. Empty array if no sales.
fields.categories[].id: Parent category id. Use null for the rolled-up Other slice.
fields.categories[].name: Display name (parent category_name). Other for leftover categories.
fields.categories[].revenue: Gross completed-order sales in that parent category. Number, not a formatted string.
fields.categories[].percentage: Share of total_revenue, 0–100. Frontend also recomputes this.

grouping_rules.level: Group by the product's parent category, not subcategory.
grouping_rules.limit: Return at most 5 named categories. If more exist, keep the top 4 by revenue and fold the rest into one Other slice.
